The Antonio Circosta Law Firm provides specialised services in Canon Law, supporting religious institutions, clergy and individuals in navigating matters governed by the rules of the Catholic Church.

Areas of Advice

  • Canonical procedures.
  • Validity of sacraments.
  • Marriage nullity cases.
  • Questions of ecclesiastical governance.

Proceedings before Ecclesiastical Tribunals

Our approach combines profound respect for spiritual principles with rigorous legal analysis. We assist clients in proceedings before ecclesiastical tribunals, ensuring that their rights are protected within the framework of canon law while maintaining consistency with civil legal systems where necessary.

International Matters

Thanks to our international experience, we are able to guide clients through issues that often cross borders, from church-state relations to the recognition of ecclesiastical decisions in civil jurisdictions.
